notes.title: Patch Available
notes.content:
A New Patch is now available. The Patch bug fixes.

Notes:
*Larilak jumping bug (The jump would lessen when you level up rather than increase)
*Unreachable areas in the Cyclop's Lair and Dragon's Lair.

Important Note: For these fixes to take place you will need to start a new game. I'm sorry for any progress lost but the changes won't work with the old save file and have a chance of returning a memory error with the old file. This error is the reason this specific game is hard to patch at the moment. A new save system like the one used in Cosmic Bounty is being worked on but will take a while in implement.

notes.title: New Patch Released - Notes
notes.content:
A New Patch is now available. The Patch includes several game crashing fixes reported.

Notes:
*Ceran Castle game crash fixed.
*Cyclops lair game crash fixed.
*Multiple treasure chest crashes fixed.
*Other game crashes that randomly fixed.
*Ciya's sprite mask corrected.
*Character attacks now hit ground enemies that previously wouldn't.
*Tileset fixes.

Important Note: For these fixes to take place you will need to start a new game. I'm sorry for any progress lost but the changes won't work with the old save file and have a chance of returning a memory error with the old file.

tags.bug: *Character attacks now hit ground enemies that previously wouldn't.

notes.title: Pre Launch Patch
notes.content: A patch is coming before the May 1st Launch Date to all of you with early access. The patch fixes a few game crashing bugs. Your original save file will no longer be valid because of this. Thanks for playing!

tags.bug: The patch fixes a few game crashing bugs.
